about.title: About
about.lead: I turn problems into working software
about.body: I'm MjavadH, a software developer focused primarily on full-stack web development. I also build desktop tools, plugins, and bots. My work spans user interfaces and user experience, as well as APIs and backend logic.
about.body2: I care about software architecture, code quality, security, and maintainability. I choose technologies according to a project’s needs and favour solutions that remain dependable and practical to extend.

items.title: A Review of PWA, SPA, and MPA Web Applications
items.description: This article compares PWA, SPA, and MPA in terms of structure, delivery, and user experience. It outlines the advantages and limitations of each approach and explains where each can fit in modern web development.

items.title: Smart Homes in the Age of the Internet of Things
